8128pub struct evp_cipher_ctx_st {

8130    pub app_data: *mut ::std::os::raw::c_void,
8131    pub cipher_data: *mut ::std::os::raw::c_void,
8132    pub key_len: ::std::os::raw::c_uint,
8133    pub encrypt: ::std::os::raw::c_int,
8134    pub flags: u32,

8144#[test]
8145fn bindgen_test_layout_evp_cipher_ctx_st() {
8146    const UNINIT: ::std::mem::MaybeUninit<evp_cipher_ctx_st> = ::std::mem::MaybeUninit::uninit();
8147    let ptr = UNINIT.as_ptr();
8148    assert_eq!(
8149        ::std::mem::size_of::<evp_cipher_ctx_st>(),
8150        152usize,
8151        "Size of evp_cipher_ctx_st"
8152    );
8153    assert_eq!(
8154        ::std::mem::align_of::<evp_cipher_ctx_st>(),
8155        8usize,
8156        "Alignment of evp_cipher_ctx_st"
8157    );
8158    assert_eq!(
8159        unsafe { ::std::ptr::addr_of!((*ptr).cipher) as usize - ptr as usize },
8160        0usize,
8161        "Offset of field: evp_cipher_ctx_st::cipher"

8869    assert_eq!(
8870        unsafe { ::std::ptr::addr_of!((*ptr).update) as usize - ptr as usize },
8871        16usize,
8872        "Offset of field: env_md_ctx_st::update"

8876        24usize,
8877        "Offset of field: env_md_ctx_st::pctx"

8882        "Offset of field: env_md_ctx_st::pctx_ops"

8884    assert_eq!(

8887        "Offset of field: env_md_ctx_st::flags"

9315#[test]
9316fn bindgen_test_layout_EC_builtin_curve() {
9317    const UNINIT: ::std::mem::MaybeUninit<EC_builtin_curve> = ::std::mem::MaybeUninit::uninit();
9318    let ptr = UNINIT.as_ptr();
9319    assert_eq!(
9320        ::std::mem::size_of::<EC_builtin_curve>(),
9321        16usize,
9322        "Size of EC_builtin_curve"
9323    );
9324    assert_eq!(
9325        ::std::mem::align_of::<EC_builtin_curve>(),
9326        8usize,
9327        "Alignment of EC_builtin_curve"
9328    );
9329    assert_eq!(
9330        unsafe { ::std::ptr::addr_of!((*ptr).nid) as usize - ptr as usize },
9331        0usize,
9332        "Offset of field: EC_builtin_curve::nid"
9333    );
9334    assert_eq!(
9335        unsafe { ::std::ptr::addr_of!((*ptr).comment) as usize - ptr as usize },
9336        8usize,
9337        "Offset of field: EC_builtin_curve::comment"
9338    );
9339}
